scripts.cf:d1:create: pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler d1 create spooktoberfest-2026
scripts.cf:d1:migrate:local: pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler --config wrangler.jsonc d1 migrations apply NOMINATIONS_DB --local
scripts.cf:d1:migrate:remote: pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler --config wrangler.jsonc d1 migrations apply NOMINATIONS_DB --remote
scripts.cf:deploy: pnpm build && pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler --config wrangler.jsonc pages deploy .svelte-kit/cloudflare --branch main
scripts.cf:dev: pnpm build && pnpm --dir apps/web exec wrangler --config wrangler.jsonc pages dev .svelte-kit/cloudflare
